title: Engineering Foundation
goal: Create a reproducible repo, local runtime, CI and architecture guardrails before feature work.

stories.title: Bootstrap monorepo
stories.value: all apps build from one documented repository
acceptanceCriteria: Repo contains web, core-api, ai-service, worker, infrastructure, docs and tests roots.
Local README documents supported toolchain and startup commands.

tasks.title: Create monorepo directories and root conventions
Add editorconfig, formatters and lint configs

stories.title: Local infrastructure with Docker Compose
stories.value: run all required local dependencies predictably
acceptanceCriteria: Docker Compose starts PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO.
Health checks make dependency readiness observable.
Local secrets are example-only and not production credentials.

tasks.title: Add PostgreSQL pgvector container and init scripts
Add Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO services
Add health checks and named volumes
Add one-command local startup smoke script

stories.title: CI quality gate
stories.value: catch formatting, test and contract failures before merge
acceptanceCriteria: Pull requests run format/lint, unit tests and YAML/JSON contract parsing.
Build fails on architecture rule violations once Core modules exist.

tasks.title: Create GitHub Actions workflow for Java

stories.title: Database migration baseline
stories.value: have one controlled owner for schema evolution
acceptanceCriteria: Initial migration creates required extensions/tables/indexes.
Migration can run from empty DB repeatedly in CI.

tasks.title: Choose Flyway or Liquibase and configure Core
Translate Phase 0 schema.sql into V1 migration
Add migration integration test on clean PostgreSQL

title: Identity & Tenant Isolation
goal: Authenticate users and enforce workspace-scoped authorization as a platform invariant.

stories.title: Register and login
stories.value: create an account and obtain a secure session
acceptanceCriteria: Valid registration creates active user and tokens.
Passwords are hashed; duplicate email is rejected.
Invalid credentials return stable error without leaking which field was wrong.

stories.title: Refresh token rotation and logout
stories.value: remain signed in safely and revoke sessions
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh token is stored hashed and rotated on use.
Reusing a revoked token is rejected.
Logout revokes the target refresh session.

stories.title: Workspace membership and RBAC
stories.value: access only workspaces where I am a member
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace creator is OWNER.
Non-member cannot read or mutate workspace resources.
Role checks are reusable across modules.

tasks.title: Add audit event for membership changes

stories.title: Google OAuth sign-in
stories.value: sign in using an external identity without weakening StudyOS authorization
acceptanceCriteria: External subject maps to one internal user identity.
OAuth provider claims never directly grant workspace access.

title: Workspace & Notebook
goal: Give learners a durable tenant-scoped place to organize goals and sources.

stories.title: Create and manage notebooks
stories.value: organize one learning topic and goal
acceptanceCriteria: Member can create/list/read/update/archive notebooks in workspace.
Cross-workspace notebook IDs are forbidden/not found safely.

stories.title: Notebook goal metadata
stories.value: state what I am trying to learn so later recommendations have context
acceptanceCriteria: Notebook can store goal text separately from title/description.
Goal metadata is returned to AI only through server-created context.

title: Source Ingestion Platform
goal: Turn heterogeneous learning sources into durable normalized, searchable data with visible processing state.

stories.title: Presigned PDF upload
stories.value: upload a document without tying up the Core API process
acceptanceCriteria: Upload-init validates membership, MIME, size and quota.
Browser uploads using short-lived signed URL.
Upload-complete queues processing only after source/object checks.

tasks.title: Implement Source/SourceVersion aggregates and state machine
Implement upload-complete endpoint and checksum checks
Build upload UI with status polling

stories.title: Transactional outbox publisher
stories.value: never lose a source-processing request after database commit
acceptanceCriteria: Source queue transition and outbox insert commit atomically.
Publisher marks event published only after broker confirm.
Restarting publisher does not lose unpublished rows.

tasks.title: Implement outbox insertion in source transaction
Implement publisher batching with SKIP LOCKED

stories.title: PDF parse and normalize worker
stories.value: convert uploaded PDF into structured text while preserving provenance
acceptanceCriteria: Worker consumes parse request idempotently.
Normalized output preserves section/page information where parser provides it.
Corrupt/unsupported documents become explicit FAILED state.

tasks.title: Write normalized artifact to object storage

stories.title: Chunk and embedding index
stories.value: make normalized source retrievable by semantic and lexical search
acceptanceCriteria: Chunks are deterministic and linked to page/section/time metadata.
Duplicate event does not create duplicate chunks.
Each chunk has embedding/config version and FTS representation.

tasks.title: Implement index worker and batch embeddings
Create FTS/vector indexes and explain plans

stories.title: Concept enrichment and READY transition
stories.value: have source concepts available for later learning features
acceptanceCriteria: Concept candidates retain supporting chunk IDs and confidence.
Duplicate normalized concepts merge deterministically within notebook.
Core marks source READY only on valid completion event.

tasks.title: Implement Core source event consumer/state validation

stories.title: URL and raw text sources
stories.value: add useful material without file upload
acceptanceCriteria: WEB/RAW source respects same notebook scope and state model.
HTML is sanitized/normalized as untrusted content.

tasks.title: Implement safe URL fetch policy/SSRF controls
Add URL content tests and block private-network targets

title: Retrieval & Grounded Chat
goal: Answer questions from user sources with validated citations and resilient real-time streaming.

stories.title: Hybrid retrieval baseline
stories.value: retrieve the most relevant source evidence for a question
acceptanceCriteria: Retrieval always applies workspace/notebook filters.
Vector and lexical results are fused into one ranked candidate list.
Debug mode exposes scores/config version to trusted users/tests.

stories.title: Grounded answer and citation validation
stories.value: verify where AI claims come from
acceptanceCriteria: Model receives only citation keys assigned by server.
Every returned citation key maps to a retrieved chunk.
Insufficient evidence produces explicit fallback, not invented citations.

tasks.title: Implement source metadata materialization in Core

stories.title: Conversation persistence
stories.value: keep durable chat history per notebook
acceptanceCriteria: Conversation/message order is deterministic.
User can only open conversations in permitted notebook.
Feedback can be recorded per assistant message.

stories.title: Production WebSocket chat
stories.value: receive streamed AI answers and recover from transient connection loss
acceptanceCriteria: Short-lived token authorizes exactly one permitted conversation.
Duplicate requestId does not create a second message.
Client can cancel and resume from buffered sequence.
Final message/citations remain durable after stream completion.

tasks.title: Implement client command parser and protocol envelope
Implement Core -> FastAPI internal streaming client
Implement sequence allocation + Redis replay buffer
Build typed WebSocket client and chat UI

stories.title: Reranking and RAG evaluation gate
stories.value: improve retrieval only when evaluation demonstrates value
acceptanceCriteria: Versioned eval dataset can compare baseline and candidate retrieval configs.
Release report includes retrieval and citation metrics plus latency/cost.

tasks.title: Add CI/offline eval command and report artifact

title: Notes & Studio
goal: Turn evidence into reusable notes and generated learning artifacts.

stories.title: Source-linked notes
stories.value: save knowledge with provenance instead of losing it in chat history
acceptanceCriteria: Note belongs to notebook/user and may reference valid citations.
Cross-notebook citation attachment is rejected.

tasks.title: Build note editor with citation chips

stories.title: Artifact job framework
stories.value: request generated study artifacts without blocking HTTP
acceptanceCriteria: Generation request returns 202/job state.
Duplicate idempotency key returns same logical job.
Failure and retry status is visible.

title: Quiz & Flashcard Active Learning
goal: Convert passive source consumption into evidence-producing practice and spaced review.

stories.title: Grounded quiz generation
stories.value: practice exactly the concepts supported by my selected sources
acceptanceCriteria: Question includes concept/source provenance.
Server rejects malformed/unsupported generated question payload.
Answer key is not exposed before completion where inappropriate.

stories.title: Quiz attempt and scoring
stories.value: complete a quiz and receive consistent results
acceptanceCriteria: Attempt can save/replace answers until completion.
Complete is idempotent and locks final score.
Objective questions score deterministically.

stories.title: Flashcard generation
stories.value: turn source concepts into reviewable recall prompts
acceptanceCriteria: Generated cards preserve source/chunk/concept provenance where available.
Duplicate generation does not silently duplicate same job.

stories.title: Spaced review scheduler
stories.value: review cards at deterministic due times based on my history
acceptanceCriteria: Queue returns only current user due cards.
Grade produces deterministic next state/date.
Concurrent duplicate review cannot be applied twice.

title: Learning State & Adaptive Recommendations
goal: Maintain explainable concept-level learner state and recommend the next high-value action.

stories.title: Mastery evidence from quiz
stories.value: have demonstrated quiz performance update my learning state
acceptanceCriteria: Quiz completion creates evidence per covered concept.
Mastery and confidence update is explainable from stored evidence.
Repeating completion does not duplicate evidence.

tasks.title: Implement mastery projection update with concurrency control

stories.title: Retention evidence from flashcard reviews
stories.value: have delayed recall affect mastery more than passive viewing
acceptanceCriteria: Concept-linked review creates weighted evidence.
Immediate repeated reviews do not unrealistically inflate mastery.

tasks.title: Wire review transaction to mastery evidence

stories.title: Mastery and concept APIs
stories.value: see what I know, what is uncertain and why
acceptanceCriteria: Mastery API returns score, confidence, evidence count and last evidence time.
Concept API returns notebook-scoped concept relationships.

stories.title: Explainable recommendation engine v0
stories.value: know the best next learning action based on goal, gaps and review urgency
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendation priority uses transparent rules/weights.
Every recommendation includes reason factors.
Engine never recommends inaccessible notebook/source.

tasks.title: Define candidate action model and score weights

title: YouTube Language Lab
goal: Turn authentic video transcripts into integrated translation, vocabulary and spaced review.

stories.title: YouTube source and transcript pipeline
stories.value: import a video as a timestamped learning source when transcript access is available
acceptanceCriteria: URL is classified as YOUTUBE and remains tenant scoped.
Transcript provider abstraction returns timestamped segments or explicit unavailable state.
Provider failure does not fabricate transcript text.

stories.title: Transcript learning UI
stories.value: navigate video and transcript together
acceptanceCriteria: Transcript displays timestamped segments.
Selecting a segment can seek video and launch analysis.

stories.title: Sentence translation/vocabulary/grammar analysis
stories.value: understand a selected authentic sentence without switching tools
acceptanceCriteria: Analysis returns structured translation, vocabulary and grammar fields.
AI receives learner level and source sentence as data, not authority.
Invalid model output is rejected/retried/fails safely.

stories.title: Save vocabulary to review
stories.value: save a useful word/phrase with context and optionally create a flashcard
acceptanceCriteria: Saved item retains source/segment context.
Create-flashcard uses the existing Review module and scheduler.

title: Adaptive Tutor Modes
goal: Use learning state and source evidence to teach interactively without letting the model become the source of truth.

stories.title: Socratic tutor mode
stories.value: be guided by questions rather than receiving an immediate answer
acceptanceCriteria: Mode uses notebook evidence and learner state context.
Tutor can ask/follow up but cannot mutate mastery merely by conversation.

tasks.title: Add mode handling in conversation protocol

stories.title: Feynman evaluation mode
stories.value: explain a concept and receive structured feedback on gaps/misconceptions
acceptanceCriteria: AI returns structured rubric with correct/missing/misconception sections.
Any mastery evidence from rubric is conservative and must pass Core validation.

tasks.title: Define Core evidence policy for rubric scores

title: Observability, Security & Production
goal: Make the beta deployable, diagnosable and resilient enough for real users.

stories.title: Distributed tracing and structured logs
stories.value: trace one user action across Core, AI, RabbitMQ and workers
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP/internal HTTP/RabbitMQ spans share trace context.
Logs include service, environment, traceId and safe resource identifiers.
Raw secrets/source content are not logged by default.

stories.title: Metrics and dashboards
stories.value: see platform, queue and AI health before users report problems
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard includes API latency/errors, queue depth/age, worker failures, WS connections and AI cost/latency.
Alert thresholds exist for critical failures.

stories.title: AI and tenant security test suite
stories.value: prevent prompt/data boundaries from becoming production vulnerabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-tenant access tests exist for every high-risk resource.
Prompt-injection corpus confirms retrieved content cannot grant tools/permissions.
URL ingestion blocks SSRF to private/metadata networks.

tasks.title: Build indirect prompt injection test corpus

stories.title: Rate limits, quotas and cost accounting
stories.value: protect provider cost and platform capacity
acceptanceCriteria: AI requests are limited by user/plan and active-generation concurrency.
Model/token/cost metrics are persisted per AI run.
Quota errors are stable and visible to client.

tasks.title: Integrate quota checks in WS/artifact flows

stories.title: Production AWS deployment with Terraform
stories.value: deploy reproducibly without manual snowflake infrastructure
acceptanceCriteria: Terraform creates environment infrastructure from reviewed configuration.
CI deploys immutable images to staging and supports controlled promotion.
TLS, secrets, backups and rollback procedure are documented/tested.

tasks.title: Configure secrets management and IAM least privilege

stories.title: Load and resilience test
stories.value: know the first bottlenecks before public beta
acceptanceCriteria: k6 test covers CRUD, chat start/WS concurrency and ingestion burst.
Results capture p95, error rates, resource usage and bottlenecks.

tasks.title: Run failure injection for provider/broker restart
Write load-test report and tuning actions

title: Product Analytics & Beta Validation
goal: Measure activation, learning loops and reliability with real users instead of optimizing feature count.

stories.title: Product event taxonomy
stories.value: measure the full source-to-mastery funnel
acceptanceCriteria: Events have stable names/properties and avoid sensitive raw content.
Activation and learning-loop events can be queried end-to-end.

stories.title: Learning overview analytics
stories.value: see outcome-focused progress rather than only time spent
acceptanceCriteria: Overview includes study activity, quiz/review outcomes and mastery changes.
Metrics clearly distinguish activity from demonstrated mastery.

stories.title: Invite beta cohort and collect feedback
stories.value: validate whether StudyOS closes a real learning loop
acceptanceCriteria: At least first invited cohort can onboard without developer database edits.
Feedback records product goal, distrust points and return intent.
Critical reliability issues are triaged before increasing cohort size.

tasks.title: Run 5-user observation sessions and record issues
